# GitHub Actions Secrets

Repo → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret

| Secret | Required | Source |
|--------|----------|--------|
| `NVIDIA_API_KEY` | Yes | https://build.nvidia.com |
| `ZERNIO_API_KEY` | For IG publish | https://zernio.com |
| `ZERNIO_IG_ACCOUNT_ID` | For IG publish | Zernio dashboard after connecting Instagram |

Manual run: Actions → Devon Daily Pipeline → Run workflow
